answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 574 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. The sparrow index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the canyon queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 6 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
